title: Backup, restore and reconciliation
brief: Choose and verify a restorable history from recovery-point and recovery-time needs. Test the backup chain and restore target, close the source history, and reconcile valid later work and external effects without duplicate application.

neighbouring_ownership.history: Owns business correction rather than database restore.
neighbouring_ownership.failover: Owns transfer to an existing live copy.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-backup: Owns native base backup and WAL procedures.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-backup: Owns native backup coverage and restore scope.

title: Replicas, lag and read routing
brief: Trace copied history through received, durable and replayed progress. Choose read routing from freshness and failure promises, including read-your-write needs, stale reads and log retention.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns native standby controls and measurements.
neighbouring_ownership.distribution: Owns quorum-based agreement within one replicated partition; this article owns copied-history progress and read routing.

title: Rebalancing and cluster change
brief: Move replicas and data while preserving authoritative history. Explain catch-up and safe membership change, and budget rebalancing and decommissioning without treating lost redundancy as spare capacity.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-operations: Owns native node removal and health evidence.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-upgrades: Owns binary rollout and finalised cluster version.
neighbouring_ownership.distribution: Establishes authoritative replicated history, acknowledgement guarantees and losing-quorum availability before this article uses replica agreement.

title: PostgreSQL physical replicas and promotion
brief: Operate a physical standby with separate receipt, flush and replay evidence. Choose synchronous promises, perform fenced promotion with an explicit loss boundary, and return a former primary safely.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-logical-replication: Owns selective row streams and their separate lifecycle.
